caption: What if you could walk through walls? Good news first: atoms are almost entirely empty space. If an atom were as big as a cricket stadium, its nucleus would be about the size of a mustard seed in the middle. So why do you go BONK? Because the electrons in your body push away the electrons in the wall. Squeeze all the empty space out of every human on Earth and what's left is roughly one sugar cube of matter, weighing billions of tonnes. Tiny particles really can slip through barriers. It's called quantum tunnelling, and stars like our Sun need it to shine. Your phone's flash memory uses tunnelling electrons to store your photos. But for a whole human, the odds are so absurdly tiny you'd keep bonking the wall for longer than the universe has existed. Plot twist: about 100 trillion neutrinos are passing through YOUR body every second. Which wall would YOU walk through first? 👇
